title: Venue capabilities, per instrument kind
description: What a venue offers for one kind of instrument (perpetual or spot), as the venue port declares it (src/venues/port.ts, Caps; Hyperliquid's values in src/venues/hyperliquid/port.ts, HL_CAPS; design 0013 decision 10). The send path refuses before signing what the venue does not offer. Price and size precision are the instrument's, not the venue's (hl-instrument).

feeRates.description: Published base maker/taker fractions for display before an account rate read (0040 amendment d28.4).

reduceOnly.description: The venue enforces reduce-only on this kind (Hyperliquid spot: no).

nativeStops.description: The venue's own trigger orders and the price they fire on; null where the venue has none for this kind or they are not used.

modify.description: A resting order is changed by cancelling it and placing a new one with a new client order id; the venue's own modify is not used.

batchOrders.description: Several orders in one signed action.

expiresAfterMs.description: Every order and cancel expires this many milliseconds after it is stamped.

buyFeeInBase.description: Added 2026-10-03 (ruling 151): a buy's fee is taken in the coin bought (Hyperliquid spot), so a DCA bot's buys are topped up from its first; fallbackRate is the venue's highest standard taker rate, a fraction (Hyperliquid spot: 0.0007), assumed when the account's own rate cannot be read. Null where the fee is taken in the quote; absent reads as null.

limitBandPct.description: Added 2026-10-03 (B13, release plan B10a): the venue's limit-distance rule, in percent: a limit order priced further than this from the venue's reference price is refused when placed (Hyperliquid perpetuals: 80, the figure of the venue's own refusal text; spot: none known). Absent: no bound, the default for a venue or kind without a known figure. gcx refuses a manual limit beyond it before signing, and a DCA bot holds a level beyond it until the price brings it inside.
